title: Concept: World-writable chmod instruction in a response
description: A chmod 777 instruction printed in a page in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: The instruction tells the reader to make a file writable by every local user, and on a shared host that turns one compromised account into a path to the application's files.
applicability: Setup guides, troubleshooting pages and support articles.
risk: World-writable application files let any local process modify code or configuration.
